changes.from: Fresenius Kabi Canada is anticipating a potential Tyenne stock shortage beginning in October. As a result, we are temporarily unable to accept new Tyenne patients. Our priority remains maintaining continuity of care and ongoing support for patients currently receiving product.
changes.to: Fresenius Kabi Canada is currently experiencing a shortage of Tyenne. The next Tyenne delivery is expected in Canada by the beginning of November and will be allocated as available.
